instagram_prompts: Macro perspective (FPP). Close-up on the grain of a massive reclaimed timber beam, a faint blue status LED reflecting off the wood. Cold morning light from a distant window. Ovolo Nishi vibe. World feels impossibly large. No humans, no nanobots.

First-person perspective (FPP). Looking up at the staggered brutalist concrete facade of the Nishi building. The sky is a flat, cold gray. Shadows are deep and sharp. Scale is overwhelming. No text, no overlays.

FPP optic capture. A polished steel surface reflecting a row of server rack lights in a dark room. The reflection is slightly distorted by the cold morning mist on the glass. Palette of charcoal and alert blue. World is enormous.
